_comment: What matters to YOU. A general-purpose model cannot infer any of this, and
getting it wrong is the difference between a digest you read and one you
ignore. Edit this file and re-run ./scripts/setup.sh — nothing else needs
about_me      free text, injected into the model's prompt as context.
always_important  regex; anything matching is forced to NEEDS YOU.
never_important   regex; anything matching is forced to IGNORED, and this
wins over the model AND over the money/receipt guards.
The two regex lists are enforced in code, not left to the model's
judgement, because a 7B model forgets a preference stated once in a long
prompt roughly as often as it remembers it.
about_me: I am NOT looking for a job. I am not job hunting, not open to offers, and not interested in roles, contracts or recruiter outreach. Any email about a job opening, a role, a vacancy, a contract position, or from a recruiter or job board is the LOWEST possible priority to me, no matter how urgent or personally addressed it looks.
I book cinema tickets through Regal as a side business, so Regal booking confirmations are important to me. Regal marketing and promotions are not.
I care about anything touching my own money or accounts: payments, transfers, statements, credit score changes, and security or sign-in alerts.
